  expected_change_site: .claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md:55 and workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md:55 (plus CLAUDE.md §25.C line 1231 and the changelog/PR description wording)

- requirement: "That go counts as the §23.C approval for opening issues or dispatching." The §31 carve-out added to CLAUDE.md §23.C must also reach the §23 reference file, per the "edit both" fragment rule and the "copied verbatim" claim.
  expected_change_site: .claude/docs/s23-github-access.md and workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md, §23.C paragraph "Command-invoked dispatches are already approved."
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Both s23 copies end at "...dispatches you would be initiating on your own judgement." and never mention §31 or the user's go, and no test (`tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py`, `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py`) checks the carve-out. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from most reviewers, NIT from openai_gpt-6-luna; highest is MAJOR.
- requirement: The changelog entry claims "the moved text is copied verbatim, so no rule was dropped" (changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md:4), which is now inaccurate.
  expected_change_site: changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md line 4 (and the PR description's equivalent wording)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The verbatim-copy claim conflicts with the missing §23.C carve-out in both s23 reference copies. Severity NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md and workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md: line 55 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The §25.C text was copied verbatim into the new reference files, including the retired token `send_later`, which `tests/test_no_session_automation.py` matches (PATTERN, line 24-25). The scan covers `.claude/` and `workflow-templates/`.
  WHY: CI run 40644284450 fails `test_no_session_automation_remains` with two hits at line 55, which fails the `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` job and the `lint` aggregate. The fix is to reword line 55 identically in both copies, for example "(the session scheduler, Routines)". CLAUDE.md line 1231 has the same token, and the "word for word" claim needs correcting.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: `send_later` must be removed from the s25 reference files for CI to pass, given the "copied verbatim" claim.
  Expected change site: .claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md:55 and workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md:55 (plus CLAUDE.md §25.C line 1231, the changelog fragment and the PR description)
  Evidence of absence: No diff hunk rewrites line 55 in either copy. Two earlier autofix runs deferred the fix because `.claude/docs/` is outside their workspace.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "That go counts as the §23.C approval for opening issues or dispatching." CLAUDE.md §23.C now carries the §31 go sentence, and the `agents.d` fragment says to edit both.
  Expected change site: .claude/docs/s23-github-access.md and workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md, §23.C paragraph "Command-invoked dispatches are already approved."
  Evidence of absence: Both s23 copies end that paragraph at "...dispatches you would be initiating on your own judgement." No test checks the carve-out.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py and tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py do not compare the §23.C wording in CLAUDE.md with the s23 reference. Suggested fix: add one assertion that the s23 reference contains the §31-go sentence (about 2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- CLAUDE.md:1452-1458 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The §31.B steps 2 and 3 rewrite is internally consistent. Step 2 no longer tells the session to run `/implement-plan-claude` before approval, and step 3 prohibits dispatching until the user's go. The earlier contradiction is resolved.
  WHY: It does not fail; the wording matches the `/write-plan` -> `/implement-plan-claude` ordering in §23.C.
- workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md and .claude/docs/s23-github-access.md: §23.C paragraph ending "...dispatches you would be initiating on your own judgement." | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The inline CLAUDE.md §23.C (lines 989-990) carries the §31 go sentence, but both s23 reference copies end at the old wording.
  WHY: A session following the pointer could re-ask for approval the §31.B.3 go already covers, and the reference files drift from the inline summary and the "edit both" rule.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The moved text is copied verbatim" (PR description §1, item 2). The s25 reference files must not contain `send_later`, and the "word for word" claim for §25.C needs updating.
  Expected change site: `.claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md:55`, `workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md:55` (plus the PR description and CLAUDE.md §25.C). Suggested reword: "(the session scheduler, Routines)" in both copies, with the test exemption list unchanged.
  Evidence of absence: CI run 40644284450 / job 122669361694 fails `test_no_session_automation_remains` (1 failed, 252 passed) with both s25 copies at line 55. The last-run diff only touched CLAUDE.md §31.B, and prior editor summaries deferred the fix as "sandbox-excluded path".
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: The §31 carve-out added to CLAUDE.md §23.C must reach the §23 reference file, per the agents fragment's "edit both" rule and the "copied verbatim" claim.
  Expected change site: `.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md` and `workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md`, §23.C paragraph "Command-invoked dispatches are already approved." Add: "Likewise, the user's go on a §31 plan approves opening the issues (or the orchestrator dispatch) that plan names."
  Evidence of absence: No hunk in either s23 copy adds the carve-out, and `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py` and `tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py` do not assert it.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: NONE
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
